items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: So I asked Mrs. D. Duarte to play the piano for me.

ctx.x: You didn't have any sons to carry on in music? I had no sons to carry on.

My daughter is an excellent pianist. My wife was an excellent pianist. I remember... And this is way back. When this... Armistice Day... Now I am going back. Armistice Day? World War One? Yeah. Mr. Gruenwald said... Not Mr. Weiss. Mr. Gruenwald. The Gruenwald said... Johnny! If possible get the band together. I said it's the middle of the day. He said well get them... Get something. We're going to have a celebration here. Armistice is having to sign at 11 o'clock. I'd like to hear the band at 12 o'clock. Well I…
